observations: A large flat-edged head shape sits against saturated yellow, split down the center into warm red-brown on the left and cool teal-blue on the right, with a white outline separating the form from the background.
Both eye positions carry looping pink crossed-oval lines over white circles; a row of small yellow-and-black ringed dots arcs across the forehead and continues down the nose bridge toward the chin.
In the lower right, a separate small dark heart-like emblem with crossed X marks and dripping red lines floats on a thin stem, distinct from the main head form.
reading: The face divides into two color fields — warm earth tones on one side, cool blue-green on the other — held together by a shared white border. The looping pink eye marks read as both decorative and unsettling, while the dot row gives the forehead a measured, almost ceremonial quality. The small dripping emblem at lower right sits apart, a second quieter presence alongside the main form.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between nnxyz nifty faces #114 and nnxyz nifty faces #116 in both title and recorded creation order. Where #114 builds its head from dense overlapping scribble marks on a grey field, #115 uses flat color blocks and a clean white silhouette edge.

connections.reason: Both works place crossed-X eye marks at the center of a head form, but #114 buries them in dense dark scribble texture while #115 floats them as clean pink loops over flat color fields — a direct contrast in surface treatment.

#116 shares the white-outline silhouette and a single crossed-X eye mark, but shifts to a magenta field and a heavily scribbled head mass, showing how the same structural device carries a different visual weight.

lookingQuestion: The row of ringed dots runs from the forehead downward — where exactly does it stop, and does its path follow the color split or cross it?
ambiguities: The small lower-right emblem contains lettering that reads as 'YAAK' or similar; treated as image content, not verified text.
nnotb #83 shows no formal overlap with this work's flat-color and dot-row structure and was excluded from connections.
